annotation_policy.preferred: Select one relationship and inspect its caption; do not enable every part label in the overview.
annotation_policy.existing_limit: Main Labels checkbox does not disable automatic section labels. viewport.settings[section_labels] controls them globally; change and restore only for a dedicated review session, not via model metadata.
annotation_policy.camera_note_limit: Camera note strings are machine metadata; existing native ModelView does not automatically display them as lesson captions.

visibility_hierarchy.overview: Keep epineurium, perineurium, endoneurium, fibre classes, fat and vessels together; hide cellular covering details and their nuclei to reduce occlusion without orphan nuclei.
visibility_hierarchy.cell_detail: Restore outer cytoplasm, basal lamina and nuclei together; remove surrounding bulk connective tissues using the existing exact-name hidden lists.
visibility_hierarchy.remak_limit: Schwann cell nuclei selector contains both parent domains; global hiding cannot choose only Remak nuclei. A per-domain mapping is needed before domain-specific lessons.
visibility_hierarchy.cutaway: Preserve original two-plane teaching cut and authored end face. Never fill nodal gaps or lumen openings to satisfy generic mesh continuity.
visibility_hierarchy.separation: Use amount=0 by default. Existing rank-driven explode separates items along model Y; it is not a tissue dissection proof or physiological movement.

vascular_policy.baseline: Disconnected representative endoneurial capillaries; no traversable vessel-network claim.
vascular_policy.candidate: Static route concept may be enabled only by explicit validated geometry status; source claim alone is insufficient.

application_path.native: Call apply_to_model(new_additive_micro_model) before constructing ProceduralModel; it copies only supported metadata. ProceduralModel copies viewer_cameras and start_view; Viewport.set_named_view consumes position/target/type/fov_deg/hidden/cut_on.
application_path.manual: In ModelView choose the named preset, then select the exact part for its description; use section controls manually for additional sections.
application_path.deferred: No new lesson UI, renderer, camera acceptance or app installation was performed.
